verdicts.reason: A breaks the hero: the sage circle is pulled away from the can and dumped behind the body copy and the 'Find It Near You' button, which makes a collision and an orphaned blob. It also leaves big dead gaps above and below the can and shrinks the CTA to badge size. B keeps the circle and can together and reads top to bottom, but the headline block sits oddly off-centre under the centred SOLSTICE wordmark and doesn't line up with the left-aligned body copy. Its CTA is also shrunk to the same weight as the two badges in one row, so the call to action gets lost.
